content: Subscription will be automatically renewed on {{finalDate}} with updated pricing and specifications — <1>{{price}}/month (Admins: {{adminsCount}} | {{perAdminPrice}} per admin)</1>

comment.text: Informational text in the payment container notifying users of an upcoming subscription renewal and updated pricing details. It includes variables for the renewal date, total monthly price, number of admins, and per-admin cost, with `<1>` tags used to format the price segment.
